say: Third, a challenging case. An angry customer, a refund outside policy, or a suspected scam.
Not working in support yet? Role-play realistic cases with a friend, and label them clearly as practice. Never present a practice case as a real job.

say: Remote support jobs are real, with titles like chat support agent or virtual assistant. A genuine offer has a clear company name, an interview first, and pay agreed in writing.

panel.heading: Real job or likely scam?
left: No fee to apply or start
right: Asks you to pay a fee
Asks for bank PIN or OTP

say: Stop and check if you are asked for a registration, training or equipment fee, if pay is far above normal, or if there is no interview. A genuine employer pays you. You do not pay them to work.
Never share your BVN, card PIN, OTP or passwords during recruitment.

say: Zainab is asked: tell me about a time you dealt with an angry customer. Situation: a customer wrote in capitals that we were scammers, after paying 12,500 naira and waiting a week.

panel.heading: Answer with STAR
items: Situation: what was happening
Task: what you needed to do
Action: exactly what you did
Result: what happened, what you improved

say: Task: I needed to calm her, find the order and get it delivered.

panel.heading: Answer with STAR
items: Situation: what was happening
Task: what you needed to do
Action: exactly what you did
Result: what happened, what you improved

say: Action: I restated her problem, apologised, asked for her order name in one message, and found the address had no street name.

panel.heading: Answer with STAR
items: Situation: what was happening

Action: exactly what you did
Result: what happened, what you improved

say: Result: it was delivered that afternoon, and I added a landmark question to our order form.
On your CV, write achievements with numbers you can back up from your sheet.

say: To remember. Choose three cases that show your range, and document each in five parts. Anonymise everything and label practice honestly.
Never pay to get a job. And build your 90-day plan from your own numbers, with an action for every target.
